lines.text: One grain of rice. It doubles every second. How long until it's bigger than the Sun?
Ten seconds: a thousand grains. A handful.
Twenty-three: enough to fill a bathtub.
Thirty seconds: your kitchen, packed to the ceiling.
Forty-seven: more rice than the Great Pyramid.
Fifty-eight: Manhattan, buried forty stories deep.
Seventy-four: the entire planet, under a meter of rice.
Ninety-five: the pile is bigger than Earth itself.
And at one hundred and sixteen seconds...
Under two minutes. That's the power of doubling. What should we double next?
